description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate via Slack reactions. Posts the upstream asset's text to a Slack channel, watches for reactions from an allowlisted set of approvers via a companion sensor, writes the same JSON approval token file `HumanApprovalGateComponent` reads — everything downstream of the gate is unchanged. Reactions-polling (not interactive buttons) so it works in Dagster+ Serverless without a public webhook.

outputs.description: One posted-asset (records Slack message_ts + metadata) + one watcher sensor (polls reactions + writes token on quorum).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset whose text is posted to Slack. Slash notation for multi-part keys.

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Approval token directory (shared with HumanApprovalGateComponent). Sensor writes `<safe_partition_key>.json` here on quorum. Accepts local paths (`/tmp/approvals`) OR cloud URIs (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gs://bucket/prefix`, `abfs://...`). Cloud URIs require the matching fsspec driver (`s3fs` / `gcsfs` / `adlfs`) — required for Dagster+ Serverless or distributed deploys where the local filesystem isn't shared across containers.

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var with `xoxb-...` bot token (needs chat:write + reactions:read + reactions:write).

ping_users_on_post.label: Ping Users On Post
ping_users_on_post.description: Slack user IDs to @-mention on the initial post so approvers get notifications.

required_approvers.label: Required Approvers
required_approvers.description: How many allowlisted approvers must react approve_emoji before the token is written.

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Slack user IDs allowed to vote.

timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours
timeout_hours.description: If quorum isn't reached within this many hours, applies on_timeout policy.

escalate_slack_user.label: Escalate Slack User
escalate_slack_user.description: User ID pinged when timeout escalates. Only used with on_timeout=escalate.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Sensor cadence for polling Slack reactions.

name: Slack Approval Gate
